_doc: AL-111: news, stories about oneself, people and places, the player's questions (content/ai/dialogue_rules/news.json, src/sim/news.hpp). {news} is a chronicle line, {news_lc} the same for mid-sentence.
dialogue.menu.ask_self: how they live, who they are
say.news.ask_news.vy: What is heard about the land, {listener}?
say.news.ask_place: {place} - what kind of place is it?
say.news.tell.rumor: Don't know if it's true, but they say {news_lc}.
say.news.tell.rumor_far: Someone told someone who told me: {news_lc}.
say.news.tell.seen: Saw it with my own eyes. {news}.
say.news.tell.road: Folk off the road carry all sorts. For one: {news_lc}.
say.news.tell.kind.war: Bad business: {news_lc}. Let's hope it doesn't reach us.
say.news.tell.kind.birth: Heard? {news}. May the child grow strong.
say.news.tell.kind.stranger: Heard? {news}. We'll see what sort they are.
say.news.tell.gossip_secret: Not a word to anyone, right? {news}.
You didn't hear it from me, but {news_lc}.
say.news.tell.kind.power: Heard? {news}. We'll see what comes of it.
say.news.no_news: Same as ever, {listener}. Haven't heard a thing.
No news, and thank the gods for that.
say.news.no_news.keeper: Odd thing: even the tavern is quiet these days.
Nothing, {listener}. As if the whole land fell asleep.
say.news.tell_story.sad: We had our grief: {news_lc}. I still think of it.
say.news.tell_story.glad: I remember that day: {news_lc}. What a joy it was.
say.news.tell_self: I'm a {self_trade}, {years} {years:plural|year|years} old. That's my life.
Not much to tell. I'm a {self_trade}, I work, I live.
say.news.tell_self.married: I'm a {self_trade}. Me, {spouse} and {children} {children:plural|child|children}. Can't complain.
A house, {spouse}, {children} {children:plural|child|children}. I work as a {self_trade} to feed them all.
say.news.tell_self.married_nokids: I'm a {self_trade}. {spouse} and I, no children yet.
{spouse} and I get on well. No children yet.
say.news.tell_self.widowed: I lost my {speaker:g|wife|husband}. Only memories now.
I'm on my own now. Work keeps my mind off it.
say.news.tell_self.chief: I'm the one in charge here. All of it's on me.
The village is mine to answer for, {listener}.
say.news.tell_self.trader: I trade a little: what comes in, I sell. I hear the news, too.
A trader. Buying, selling, that's me.
say.news.tell_self.keeper: I keep the tavern. All the news ends up with me first.
say.news.tell_self.elder: I'm old now, {years} years. I've seen a lot.
I've lived a while, {listener}. I remember things you young ones never heard of.
say.news.tell_self.child: I'm {years} and I help a lot at home!
say.news.tell_person.listener: Ha! You want me to tell you about you?
say.news.tell_person.kin.spouse: My {person}? Hale and hearty, thank you.
say.news.person_remark.plain: Keeps to themselves, bothers no one.
say.news.person_remark.liked: One of the kindest, you won't find better.
say.news.person_remark.disliked: I don't like {person:g|him|her}, I'll say it plainly.
{person} and I don't see eye to eye.
say.news.person_remark.feared: I'm a little afraid of {person:g|him|her}, truth be told.
say.news.person_remark.distrust: I wouldn't trust {person:g|him|her} with a copper.
say.news.person_remark.enemy: {person:g|He|She} is my enemy. Nothing more to say.
say.news.person_remark.trusted: You can rely on {person:g|him|her}, I know it.
say.news.person_remark.chief_good: A sound head, life's good under {person:g|him|her}.
say.news.person_remark.chief_bad: Not much use, though, between us.
say.news.person_remark.kin: You don't speak ill of your own.
Blood is blood, what can I say.
say.news.tell_place.ruler: {place}? A {place_size} {place_dir}, {place_km} {place_km:plural|mile|miles} off. {ruler} is the master there.
say.news.tell_place.camp: {place}? A nest of bandits {place_dir}, {place_km} {place_km:plural|mile|miles} away. Don't go there.
{place} is an outlaw camp {place_dir}. {ruler} leads them.
say.news.place_remark.war: We're at war with them. Don't set foot there.
say.news.place_remark.ally: We're allied with them, good people.
Friends of ours, they won't leave us in trouble.
say.news.place_remark.pays_us: They're under our hand, they bring tribute.
say.news.place_remark.we_pay: We pay them tribute, curse them.
We pay them every month. Galling, but what can you do.
say.news.place_remark.liege: Our lord is from there. We bow to them.
say.news.place_remark.grudge: Folk here don't like them: too many wrongs.
They've brought us nothing but trouble.
say.news.place_remark.trade: There's a big market, you can buy anything.
say.news.place_remark.fortified: High walls, you'd never take it.
say.news.place_remark.cult: Strange folk, they pray to something of their own.
I wouldn't bow to their gods.
say.news.place_remark.raiders: They come raiding us from there.
say.news.decline_ask: I've nothing to say to you.
say.news.decline_ask.enemy: After all that, you ask me? Get lost.
say.news.place_remark: I don't know much more about them.
Haven't been there in a long while.
say.news.discuss.sad: I still can't get over it: {news_lc}.
say.news.discuss.spicy: What a business: {news_lc}. Who'd have thought!
say.news.discuss.kind.raid: My heart still jumps when I think of the raid. {news}.
Since the raid I can't sleep. {news}.
say.news.discuss.kind.war: This war... {news}. Hope they don't take us too.
Heard about the war? {news}. Uneasy times.
say.news.discuss.kind.wedding: Remember the wedding? {news}. A fine pair.
say.news.discuss.kind.stranger: These strangers... {news}. What do you make of them?
say.news.discuss.mine_sad: I keep thinking of our grief: {news_lc}.
say.news.react.mine_sad: My own heart's not easy either.
say.news.react.story: Aye, I remember those days too.
say.news.react.story_sad: Hold on, {listener}. What's done is done.
Oh... sorry I brought it up.
goal.share_news.name: Share the news
goal.share_news.thought: Someone ought to hear what I heard.
say.news.tell.kind.magic: {news}. I didn't see it myself, but people say so.
say.news.discuss.kind.magic: I keep thinking of that magic: {news_lc}. Good or ill?
say.news.tell.kind.dark_magic: Heard? {news}. Bar your door at night.
say.news.discuss.kind.dark_magic: I can't stop thinking: {news_lc}. The dead should lie still.
say.news.tell.kind.witch_trial: So it came to us too: {news_lc}.
say.news.discuss.kind.witch_trial: I keep thinking of the trial: {news_lc}. Was it just?
{news}. Harsh, but maybe it had to be.
say.news.tell.kind.dragon: Heard? {news}. They'll make songs of it.
say.news.discuss.kind.dragon: The dragon is slain: {news_lc}. We can breathe again.
